lines: The job. The *client.* The person. The opportunity.
It makes you wonder if you're good *enough.*
#Every no moves you one step closer to the right *yes.*
#The people who succeed don't get rejected *less.*
They apply again. They pitch *again.* They knock on the next door.
Every successful person has a pile of *nos* behind them.
If you're not hearing no, you're not aiming high *enough.*
#So take the lesson, if there is one.
end: Follow for your daily push at 7am & 7pm.

post.title: They Said No? Keep Going.
post.caption: If you're not hearing no, you're not aiming high enough. 🚪
post.first_comment: What's the best 'no' that ever happened to you? 👇
